summary_en: Urarunet Advertising Group (9235) signed a basic agreement to acquire all shares of Light Co., an AI service development and digital content operations company with operating profit in black and up to ¥250M in sales. Deal structure, purchase price, and closing date not yet disclosed; definitive agreements to follow.
title_en: Notice of Execution of Basic Agreement on Full Subsidiary Acquisition of Light Co. (AI Service Development and Operations Company with Operating Profit in Black and Sales Up to ¥250 Million) through Share Acquisition by Urarunet Advertising Group
translation_en_brief: Urarunet Advertising Group Co., Ltd. (TSE Growth: 9235) announced execution of a basic agreement to acquire all shares of Light Co. and make it a wholly owned subsidiary. Light Co. operates digital content operations support, quality verification and testing, and AI service development and operations businesses, with operating profit currently in black and sales of up to ¥250 million. The company is advancing the 'Tacit Hub' concept to convert implicit knowledge and expertise accumulated within enterprises into AI-usable assets. Urarunet intends to leverage Light's AI development capabilities, operations expertise, and enterprise knowledge utilization technology to accelerate its own AI strategy, particularly by combining Light's technical platform with Urarunet's marketing know-how, advertising execution track record, and customer base to enhance AI adoption support and AEO (AI Search Optimization) services. The filing provides no purchase price, share count, ownership stake percentage, or specific closing timeline; definitive agreements are to follow.
